subject: general
question: In a competitive exam with 120 questions, there are three sections: General Knowledge (20 questions), Reasoning (50 questions), and English (50 questions). A candidate answered 70% of General Knowledge, 50% of Reasoning, and 30% of English questions correctly. If the minimum passing score is 60%, how many more questions did the candidate need to answer correctly to pass?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Target questions to pass = 60% of 120 = 72

Current correct questions = (70% of 20) + (50% of 50) + (30% of 50)

⇒ 14 + 25 + 15 = 54

Questions needed to pass = 72 − 54 = 18

**∴ The correct answer is 18 questions.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total questions = 120

General Knowledge questions = 20, correctly answered = 70%

Reasoning questions = 50, correctly answered = 50%

English questions = 50, correctly answered = 30%

Minimum passing score = 60% of total questions
